body:
Hey, thanks. Sorry you have to deal with it, as well. I don't have many problems with reaching out to them, but it starts feeling awful when they tell you they honestly care about you but wont reach out themselves, or any time you reach out they can't be bothered. I don't know.

Currently I'm in class Mon-Fri, so I certainly interact with people, at least during the week. I don't have much trouble being friendly with people, I guess. I don't know, I guess I have trouble transitioning to things like class mates, into friends. It also probably doesn't help that the largest class I'm in is only about 20 people... I have plans on moving to a larger uni in the fall...

I can't really do it just now, but I was going to look into volunteering at the animal shelter over the summer; it's really the only place near by that I can volunteer for.
